title: Harden the schema-1 bridge before schema-2 activation
body:
## Scope

Prepare the independently reviewable schema-1 bridge required by owner-directed R3/migration §16.3. Schema remains **1**. No schema-2 activation, migration replay, capacity change, merge, tag or release. Activation remains blocked until the actual required bridge is available and pinned.

- Raw owned marker/primary/previous admission rejects missing, invalid, unknown, target or duplicate schema declarations; ordinary same-schema corruption recovery is preserved.
- Strict five-key `migration-terminal.json`: operationId, protocolVersion=1, strict versions:{from,to}, outcome, bindingDigest. Only 2→1/rolled-back admits the bridge, never as ownership or replay authority. Active transition/privacy fences always refuse.
- Synchronous owned-store writers claim the existing exclusive lock or reuse their operation-local live context. Direct contention refuses; waiting transactions re-admit; retired Tx writers refuse. Read-only artifact inspection never creates/chmods directories. Stateless advisory artifacts remain unbound; unbound blobs cannot create a store.
- Real-process direct/waiting-writer and SIGKILL/restart controls, plus built-bundle terminal/fence interruption UAT. Synthetic publishers are tests, not migrators.
- Actual source/toolchain and bundle/payload/input hashes. See [contract and reproduction](docs/schema-1-bridge.md).

## Independent review and observed evidence

Fresh-context scope review findings B1–B4 were disposed before implementation; independent implementation review reported no significant findings. Failing-first controls, typecheck, lints, structural coverage, focused Windows controls, payload verification and independent clean-output builds were observed.

At previous head `3362c50145f7fd177a6b2fe62ff623aac601b3ce`, Ubuntu full CI passed all **1,792 tests with no skips**, but bundle UAT exposed an invalid test invocation (`status` instead of registered `inspect --view status`). Corrected only the UAT invocation in `1af05109b0712ebd285a8382a9d4a818e12fb12a`. Windows bridge controls passed; unrelated starter tests hit five-second timeouts. The old queued macOS job was superseded, not observed passing.

Current exact-head [push gates](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42410505990) and [PR gates](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42410509171) remain **pending**. Ubuntu/macOS full CI and Node 24/22.12 bundle UAT must pass before review-ready delivery. Full local Windows CI failed (1,136 pass, 631 fail, 25 skip); unsupported POSIX mutation is not supported-host evidence.

## Actual candidate identity

Clean committed source: `1af05109b0712ebd285a8382a9d4a818e12fb12a`, `sourceDirty:false`. Local Node `v24.22.1`, esbuild `0.28.2`, TypeScript `5.9.3`; two independent empty-output builds, 97 payload files:

| Artifact | Actual SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `plugin/kernel/tenet.mjs` | `bcea82fbe2665596608b178196f481cc0a4c84573336578fc4195915703ffe39` |
| complete `plugin/SHA256SUMS` bytes | `926a07a81a344716588e45b0fdf0e1836940d633faa2b6e6caac824af2579793` |
| source + installed compiler input snapshot | `4c137ca3645de0caa5249ccaa1c2d11e81072f7758ae9ea6b72d774e75cc33e5` |

These are **candidate build digests**, not a published release identity, publisher authentication, host qualification or approved bridge pin. Input hashes are platform/toolchain-specific. Installed-host and power-loss behavior remain unobserved. Staged and upstream-range privacy found no likely leaks; scans provide no absence guarantee.
